releaseBoundary: These lanes are URPG product-depth follow-through, not bounded v0.1.0 release blockers unless a future release scope promotes them into mandatory exit criteria.

lanes.title: Battle feedback fixture depth
lanes.remainingDepth: Governed FRL-01 battle feedback fixture depth is complete for the current scope.
currentEvidence: battle presentation profile and panel evidence counts
nextImplementation: Keep future battle feedback fixture variants covered by the same import diagnostics and coverage-row contract.
Route newly discovered plugin aliases through the existing normalized policy importer instead of adding parallel policy paths.
Open a new FRL or issue if future battle presentation work expands beyond the completed chip, zero-damage, buff-cap, and troop-position scope.
verificationCommands: ctest --preset dev-all -R "BattleRuleResolver|battle presentation|Compat fixture import: battle feedback" --output-on-failure

lanes.title: State/message/picture fixture import depth
lanes.remainingDepth: Compat migration now preserves dropped state/picture fixture rows beside diagnostics; remaining depth is broader fixture import files and rendered high-count picture fixture snapshots.
nextImplementation: Add dedicated fixture imports for scoped banks, self/map/JS variables, nested escapes, and picture task triggers.
Add high-count picture fixture snapshots outside the unit-only preview coverage.
Promote FRL-02 to ready once compat fixture files and rendered picture snapshot evidence exist.

lanes.title: Progression visual controls
lanes.remainingDepth: Complete for the governed FRL-03 scope: stat allocation snapshots expose pool rows, stat steppers, cap warnings, disabled reasons, post-load apply controls, and a renderer-facing control panel contract.
nextImplementation: Keep future progression UIs consuming the shared stat_allocation_control_panel contract.
Open a new FRL if direct interactive ImGui mutation handlers become release scope.
Preserve cap-warning and disabled-reason coverage for future stat allocation rules.

lanes.title: Ability task-graph runtime sequencing
lanes.remainingDepth: Complete for the governed FRL-04 scope: task graph runtime sequencing reports cursor, wait state, branch transitions, effects, cue rows, cancellation, replay rows, and deterministic async scheduler rows for waits that span frames.
nextImplementation: Keep arbitrary scripting behind the explicit unsupported/sandbox status until a safe API is defined.
Open a new FRL if wall-clock async execution or scripting callbacks become release scope.
Preserve deterministic_frame_replay fixture evidence for CI-friendly task sequencing coverage.

lanes.title: Asset promotion and preview depth
lanes.remainingDepth: Complete for the governed FRL-05 scope: action and preview rows expose package/readiness diagnostics, thumbnail/waveform/sequence evidence, promotion manifests, and a renderer-facing readiness badge contract.
nextImplementation: Keep future asset UI consuming the shared asset_readiness_badge_stack contract.
Open a new FRL for new curated payload groups or generated media pipelines beyond the current manifest coverage.
Preserve explicit missing license, missing payload, thumbnail, waveform, and sequence diagnostics.

lanes.title: Painted AI diff rendering
lanes.remainingDepth: Complete for the governed FRL-06 scope: painted diff rows, selected details, blocked-apply reasons, and a renderer-facing diff panel contract are shared by editor/chatbot snapshots.
nextImplementation: Keep future AI patch renderers consuming the shared render_contract and rows instead of reinterpreting JSON patches.
Open a new FRL if interactive side-by-side visual diff editing becomes release scope.
Preserve blocked-apply reasons in all future AI apply surfaces.

lanes.title: Automatic project filesystem walking
lanes.remainingDepth: Complete for the governed adapter-backed FRL-07 scope: bounded crawler output is indexed, diagnostics are visible, and editor/chatbot refresh controls expose a deterministic crawler invocation manifest.
nextImplementation: Keep production crawler execution behind the documented invocation manifest and ingest command contract.
Add future larger-repository stress fixtures only if crawler limits or include/exclude policies change.
Open a new FRL if live background indexing or file-watcher behavior becomes release scope.

lanes.title: Broader AI validator invocation
lanes.remainingDepth: Complete for the governed adapter-backed FRL-08 scope: AI validation reports route preview artifacts through typed subsystem validator adapter contracts with deterministic fixture inputs, output paths, fallback rows, and no external credentials.
nextImplementation: Keep future concrete AI validators behind the ai_preview_typed_validator_adapter contract.
Open a new FRL if production validation delegates to long-running external tools or credentialed services.
Preserve fallback diagnostics for preview kinds without typed subsystem inputs.

lanes.title: Socket-level live chat streaming
lanes.remainingDepth: Complete for the governed adapter-backed FRL-09 scope: stream requests expose deterministic chunk diagnostics, curl --no-buffer live delivery, provider/cancel/error diagnostics, and an explicit stream adapter plan.
nextImplementation: Keep future socket providers behind the openai_compatible_stream_adapter contract.
Open a new FRL if a persistent non-curl socket client becomes release scope.
Preserve deterministic stream diagnostics for CI and provider debugging.

lanes.title: Native signing, notarization, and smoke launch depth
lanes.remainingDepth: Complete for the governed adapter-backed FRL-10 scope: export validation reports platform policy rows, provider adapter metadata, missing credential diagnostics, launched-smoke evidence paths, and release blocking counts.
nextImplementation: Keep production signing/notarization behind the platform_artifact_policy_adapter contract.
Open a new FRL if credentialed provider execution becomes mandatory release scope.
Preserve explicit dev_unsigned and missing_evidence states for non-release local validation.
